text: {"verdicts":[{"i":0,"v":"UNSUPPORTED","u":null,"why":"The patient did not report pain on passing urine."},{"i":1,"v":"UNSUPPORTED","u":null,"why":"The patient did not report pain on passing urine for the last 2 days."},{"i":2,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":21,"why":"The patient mentioned pink urine."},{"i":3,"v":"UNSUPPORTED","u":null,"why":"The patient could not say with certainty if there was blood in the urine."},{"i":4,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":32,"why":"The patient stated there was no burning or stinging pain when passing urine."},{"i":5,"v":"UNSUPPORTED","u":null,"why":"The patient did not report vomiting."},{"i":6,"v":"UNSUPPORTED","u":null,"why":"The patient did not mention any fever."},{"i":7,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":21,"why":"The patient stated that her bowel movements are normal now."},{"i":8,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":60,"why":"The patient stated she has no surgical history."},{"i":9,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":44,"why":"The patient mentioned she is on Implanon."},{"i":10,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":59,"why":"The patient stated she has no other partners and is not using any other contraception."}]}
